design_notes: In-state: lines 183-185 allow Southwest's non-refundable fare, which is also below the 15400 contract fare (167-168) and the lowest cost airfare. The traveller accepts the connection and the training is the next day. Booked December 10 for December 15: 5 days, less than 7 (220), and Concur asks for the justification before it books (224-226), so the reason given is a justification this booking needs: short notice, or Southwest as a non-contracted carrier (218).
